basics.name: David
basics.label: Frontend Developer
basics.summary:
Frontend developer focused on building clean, thoughtful interfaces — from reusable components to the details users notice. I care that experiences work well and feel good to use.

I adapt quickly and stay curious: I follow industry trends, new tools, and how AI is changing the way we build software.

Alongside frontend work, I use Unity on interactive projects and bring 3D modeling skills — a wider perspective that helps on cross-disciplinary digital products.

highlights: Built a new Role-Play product integrating SCAI (WebSockets) and AI Factory (LLMs for scoring).
Created components and widgets for Syntphony Learning Tech (PHP, Moodle, HTML, JavaScript).
Shipped features for the Syntphony Immersive Experiences admin portal, including OTP login.
Developed the web version of Syntphony Immersive Experiences with WebGL and Unity.
Maintained Syntphony Immersive Experiences documentation (Nextra, MD/MDX).
Migrated the design system for the Syntphony Immersive Experiences portal.
Maintained and optimized frontend CI/CD pipelines: E2E tests, unit tests, and build performance.
Built new features for the Allianz eCliente mobile app.
Delivered an Angular fundamentals course for Allianz teams.
Implemented XL insurance flows in Angular 12, fixing bugs and refactoring components (MAPFRE).
Migrated styles and features for the Servihabitat portal on Liferay (CaixaBank).
Built a calendar widget as a Liferay portlet (Educaixa/CaixaBank).
Created SPAs for Ready-for-Proposal (RFP) sites with high-impact demos in Angular 9 (SEAT and Orange).
Built a design system with Storybook and Stencil.
Proof of concept: exporting Figma design tokens into a design system.
Built reusable web components with Angular 8 (Allianz).
Researched and built proof-of-concept demos for the Phygital department.
Developed VR training apps with Unity for USIX 2.0 in the industrial sector.
Built the Casa SEAT retail car configurator with Adobe Experience Manager (SEAT: CODE).

projects.name: Estudi Seitai
projects.description: Website for a Seitai and katsugen movement studio
highlights: Marketing site for a Seitai and katsugen movement studio
Built as a static Astro site with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
Live production site at estudiseitai.cat
projects.longDescription: Marketing website for Estudi Seitai, a Seitai and katsugen movement practice based in Catalonia. Built as a fast static Astro site with TypeScript and Tailwind, it presents the practice, studios, and contact paths in Catalan with a calm, editorial layout suited to the brand.

projects.name: Eclipse Viewer
projects.description: Interactive 3D visualizer of solar and lunar eclipses
highlights: Interactive 3D visualizer of solar and lunar eclipses
Classroom scale vs true scale, with orbit and camera controls
React + TypeScript + Three.js (React Three Fiber)
projects.longDescription: Interactive 3D visualizer of solar and lunar eclipses. Distances and sizes use a classroom scale by default so the Moon's 5° orbital tilt is easy to see, with a true-scale toggle for real size and distance ratios. Built with React, TypeScript, Three.js and React Three Fiber, it starts paused on the 12 August 2026 total solar eclipse, with English and Catalan UI.

projects.name: Stashly
projects.description: Mobile-first static app to find household items with QR-tagged storage
highlights: Mobile-first static app to find household items
QR codes for storage spaces and client-side fuzzy search
Next.js + TypeScript, deployed to GitHub Pages
projects.longDescription: Mobile-first static web app for finding where household items are stored. Tag cupboards and drawers with QR codes, then scan and search by keyword with client-side fuzzy matching. Built with Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, with Catalan inventory data and a Catalan, Spanish and English UI, deployed as a static PWA on GitHub Pages.

projects.name: Spritz Reader
projects.description: Speed-reading web app using the Spritz technique (spec-driven development)
highlights: Speed-reading web app based on the Spritz RSVP technique
Built with a spec-driven development workflow
React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
projects.longDescription: Browser speed-reading app based on the Spritz RSVP technique: words appear one at a time around a fixed focal point so readers can raise WPM without eye scanning. Built with React, Vite, TypeScript and Tailwind using a spec-driven workflow, with language switching and adjustable reading speeds.

projects.name: Seat RFP
projects.description: Interactive page with three Canvas minigames (SEAT)
highlights: Interactive proposal page with three Canvas minigames for SEAT
Angular + TypeScript frontend
Client-facing demo for an RFP
projects.longDescription: Interactive RFP experience for SEAT built with Angular and Canvas. Visitors explore a branded narrative through three mini-games that showcase proposal ideas in a playful, client-facing format rather than a static slide deck.

projects.name: Orange RFP
projects.description: Landing page with a card minigame (Orange)
highlights: Landing experience with a card-based minigame for Orange
Angular + TypeScript with Lottie motion
Client-facing demo for an RFP
projects.longDescription: Landing experience for Orange featuring a card-based minigame. Built with Angular, TypeScript and Lottie motion to turn an RFP pitch into an interactive story about user-centred services.

projects.name: HMI Seat
projects.description: Interactive page with a brand chronology timeline (SEAT)
highlights: Interactive brand chronology timeline for SEAT
Angular + TypeScript UI
Narrative browsing of historical brand moments
projects.longDescription: Interactive brand chronology for SEAT that invites visitors to travel through iconic cars and historical moments. An Angular + TypeScript UI frames the timeline as a guided narrative rather than a static archive.

projects.name: Cinemup
projects.description: TV recommendation app for Samsung Smart TV (Tizen Studio)
highlights: TV recommendation app targeting Samsung Smart TV (Tizen)
Built with JavaScript, HTML and CSS
Academic project focused on living-room UX
projects.longDescription: TV-oriented recommendation experience aimed at Samsung Smart TV (Tizen). A remote-friendly JavaScript interface helps users browse curated movie and series collections designed for living-room viewing.

projects.name: PodRacers
projects.description: Video game prototype built with Unreal Engine 4
highlights: Racing video game prototype in Unreal Engine 4
Gameplay and systems work in C++
Academic prototype exploring vehicle feel and track flow
projects.longDescription: Academic racing prototype in Unreal Engine 4 with C++ gameplay systems. Focuses on vehicle feel, track flow and HUD feedback in a sci-fi canyon setting — a vertical slice rather than a full commercial release.

projects.name: Ricardlogic
highlights: Word game inspired by Paraulògic
Lightweight HTML / CSS / JavaScript build
Playable browser minigame
projects.longDescription: Lightweight browser word game inspired by Paraulògic. Players form Catalan words from a hexagonal letter set with shuffle, delete and score tracking, built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

projects.name: Portfolio v1
projects.description: Previous portfolio version built with Angular
highlights: Previous personal portfolio built with Angular
TypeScript + SCSS component architecture
Superseded by the current Astro site
projects.longDescription: First long-lived personal portfolio, built with Angular, TypeScript and SCSS. It established the DGM brand system and project storytelling patterns later refined in the current Astro site.

projects.name: AMIGO
projects.description: Minimal hypercasual minigolf game built with Unity
highlights: Minimal hypercasual minigolf game in Unity
Gameplay and shaders with C# and HLSL
Published on itch.io
projects.longDescription: Hypercasual minigolf game made in Unity with C# and HLSL. Minimal levels, click-and-drag shots and a bright low-poly look — published on itch.io as a short, approachable play session.

projects.name: Instruments List
projects.description: Site to explore instrument families, built with Angular
highlights: Browsable catalogue of instrument families
Angular + TypeScript frontend
Exploratory UI for musical instrument taxonomy
projects.longDescription: Catalan catalogue for exploring musical instrument families. An Angular front end presents instrument cards with expandable detail panels for descriptions, links and media.

projects.name: Light Sorter
highlights: Filterable product/element grid for Endesa
Isotope-powered layout with jQuery and Handlebars
Client deliverable focused on browse and filter UX
projects.longDescription: Filterable element grid delivered for Endesa using Isotope, jQuery and Handlebars. Visitors sort and browse colour-coded values in a dense interactive board built for client demos.

projects.name: Shaders & Postpro
projects.description: Real-time post-processing effects with fragment shaders and ImGui
highlights: Real-time post-processing effects with fragment shaders
C++ + GLSL with ImGui controls
Academic exploration of image effects pipelines
projects.longDescription: Real-time post-processing playground in C++ and GLSL with ImGui controls. Toggles effects such as colour correction, posterize, dithering and pixelize on a 3D scene to study image-effect pipelines.
